versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the intent-engineering skill for OpenClaw agents.
- Adds machine-readable INTENT.md support to specify priorities, tradeoffs, and delegation rules.
- Integrates intent context into all subagent spawns using agent-context-loader.
- Ensures subagents are aware of explicit optimization goals—not just tasks.
- Solves issues with agents optimizing metrics instead of true objectives (“Klarna failure mode”).
- Includes templates and reference implementations for easy setup.
